content: Lipgloss side-by-side layout: lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, leftPane, rightPane). Set width with style.Width(n). Get dimensions after render: lipgloss.Width(block), lipgloss.Height(block). For split panes: create left/right styles with explicit widths summing to terminal width minus separators. Alignment options: Top/Center/Bottom for vertical alignment when joining horizontally. Placement: lipgloss.PlaceHorizontal/PlaceVertical for positioning blocks.
